managedIpRanges.description: An array of dotted-decimal IPv4 address ranges that should be managed by the network tunnel service on this Jumpoint. If the Network Tunnel feature will be used on one or more networks which do not provide a DHCP service, provide ranges from which allocations can be made for access sessions. An IP address for each network that the filter rules of a Protocol Tunnel Jump Shortcut allows will be allocated to a user while participating in a session. Take care to provide ranges that do not contain IP addresses which could be used by other systems on that network.

isJzpEnabled.description: Indicates whether the Jump Zone Proxy feature is enabled. This value can be null in responses for Jumpoints created before an upgrade until the Jumpoint connects for the first time after the upgrade.

jzpProxyHostname.description: The hostname of the Jump Zone Proxy server. This parameter is only used for standalone Jumpoints and is only valid if the Jump Zone Proxy is enabled. This value can be null in responses for Jumpoints created before an upgrade until the Jumpoint connects for the first time after the upgrade.

jzpProxyPort.description: TCP Port of the Jump Zone Proxy. Only valid when the Jump Zone Proxy is enabled. This value can be null in responses for Jumpoints created before an upgrade until the Jumpoint connects for the first time after the upgrade.

isJzpHttpGetAllowed.description: If enabled, HTTP GET requests are permitted through the proxy to the BeyondTrust appliance, and this setting is only applicable if the Jump Zone Proxy is enabled. This value can be null in responses for Jumpoints created before an upgrade until the Jumpoint connects for the first time after the upgrade.

jzpClientAddressRestrictionsType.description: The type of client address restrictions to apply to the JZP. If set to no-restriction, the jzpRestrictedIps field is ignored. If set to allow-all, the jzpRestrictedIps field is used to specify a list of allowed network address prefixes. If set to deny-all, the jzpRestrictedIps field is used to specify a list of denied network address prefixes.

jzpRestrictedIps.description: Array of network address prefixes, where netmasks are optional and can be specified in either dotted-decimal or integer bitmask format. If a netmask is omitted, the entry is assumed to be a single IP address. This field is only valid if the jzpClientAddressRestrictionsType is set to allow-all or deny-all.

hasScheduledAccessRestriction.description: If true, users are restricted to accessing Jump Items within the scheduled hours. This setting cannot be enabled when require approval is true.

simultaneousJumpsType.description: If set to join, once the first user is in a session, subsequent users will be able to enter the session. The first user will receive a notification that another user has joined the session, but the first user will not have an opportunity to deny access before other user joins. Selecting the global value means that the behavior defined in Jump Items will be used.

doesSimultaneousJumpBehaviorApplyToCopie.description: This field is only valid if simultaneousJumpsType is set to join; otherwise, this field should be set to false or left unset. If true, a user will be allowed to join a session that was started from another copy of a Jump Client in a different Jump Group. Session permissions will be based on the original Jump Client that started the session. If false, a user will not be allowed to join a session that was started from another copy of a Jump Item unless it is the same Jump Group.

simultaneousJumpsRdpType.description: If set to new-session, then a new independent session will start for each user which jumps to a specific RDP Jump Item, and the RDP configuration on the endpoint will control any further behavior regarding simultaneous RDP connections. Selecting the global value means that the behavior defined in Jump Items will be used.

shouldForceRemoveUsersWhenScheduleDisall.description: If true, users are forcefully removed from sessions when the schedule does not permit access. This can only be set to true if hasScheduledAccessRestriction is also true.

isTicketIdRequired.description: If true, users must enter a valid ticket ID that will be verified against the Ticket System configured in the Jump Policies. This setting has no effect if a Ticket System is not configured.

isTwoFactorChallengeRequired.description: If true, users must have two factor authentication enabled and must complete a two factor challenge before starting a session.

isSessionStartNotificationEnabled.description: If true, an email notification is sent to the configured recipients when a session starts.

isSessionEndNotificationEnabled.description: If true, an email notification is sent to the configured recipients when a session ends.

notificationEmailAddresses.description: The list of email addresses to which session start and session end notifications will be sent. Required only if one or more notifications are enabled. The site must have an SMTP server configured on the Email Configuration.

notificationDisplayName.description: The display name of the recipients shown to users. Required in POST only if one or more notifications are enabled.

notificationEmailLanguage.description: The language in which notification emails will be sent. Must be the locale code for one of the locales listed.

isApprovalRequired.description: If true, users must wait for approval from one of the approvers before they can start a session. This setting cannot be enabled when hasScheduledAccessRestriction is true.

approvalMaxDurationInMinutes.description: The number of minutes a user is allowed to access the Jump Item after approval is granted. The maximum is 52 weeks in minutes.

approvalScopeType.description: The scope of access granted by approvals. If "requestor", only the requestor has access. If "anyone", anyone who is permitted to request access has access.

codeName.description: The code name of the Jump Policy.

hasScheduledAccessRestriction.description: If true, users are restricted to accessing Jump Items within the scheduled hours. This setting cannot be enabled when require approval is true.

simultaneousJumpsType.description: If set to join, once the first user is in a session, subsequent users will be able to enter the session. The first user will receive a notification that another user has joined the session, but the first user will not have an opportunity to deny access before other user joins. Selecting the global value means that the behavior defined in Jump Items will be used.

doesSimultaneousJumpBehaviorApplyToCopie.description: This field is only valid if simultaneousJumpsType is set to join; otherwise, this field should be set to false or left unset. If true, a user will be allowed to join a session that was started from another copy of a Jump Client in a different Jump Group. Session permissions will be based on the original Jump Client that started the session. If false, a user will not be allowed to join a session that was started from another copy of a Jump Item unless it is the same Jump Group.

simultaneousJumpsRdpType.description: If set to new-session, then a new independent session will start for each user which jumps to a specific RDP Jump Item, and the RDP configuration on the endpoint will control any further behavior regarding simultaneous RDP connections. Selecting the global value means that the behavior defined in Jump Items will be used.

shouldForceRemoveUsersWhenScheduleDisall.description: If true, users are forcefully removed from sessions when the schedule does not permit access. This can only be set to true if hasScheduledAccessRestriction is also true.

isTicketIdRequired.description: If true, users must enter a valid ticket ID that will be verified against the Ticket System configured in the Jump Policies. This setting has no effect if a Ticket System is not configured.

isTwoFactorChallengeRequired.description: If true, users must have two factor authentication enabled and must complete a two factor challenge before starting a session.
